name: lock_server_sync-s60-r1
cmd: GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 GDP_GOAL_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only lock_server_sync --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set|goal|startcheck)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-260 | tail -c 40000; exit $s
